ideas.name: flip1 on a strong-bodied bar
ideas.why: a flip made by a bar that closes near its extreme the flip's way was pushed by real orders, not drift

ideas.name: flip1 far from the 5m EMA (chasing)
ideas.why: a flip that comes after price has already run far past the 5m trend line is late (expected to hurt)

ideas.name: flip1 with room to the day's expected range
ideas.why: a flip with more than half the usual range still unused its way has somewhere to go

ideas.name: flip1 after a big swing the other way
ideas.why: a flip that ends a swing of 3 x 5m ATR is a real turn after an overextension

ideas.name: potE1 with the 5m row warning too
ideas.why: momentum easing on both timeframes at once is a broader slowdown than one row's

ideas.name: potM1 at VWAP's 2-sigma band
ideas.why: easing momentum at a statistical extreme of the session's distribution

ideas.name: potE1 on a doji with heavy volume
ideas.why: indecision on heavy volume is a fight that the warned side is winning

ideas.name: flip1 against VWAP slope
ideas.why: confirmed #1's logic on flips: a flip the way VWAP is already drifting may be late
